name: Conekta

webhook.algorithm: Header `Digest` (documented uppercase as 'DIGEST'). Algorithm is RSA signature over SHA-256 of the raw UTF-8 body, base64-encoded — ASYMMETRIC, verified with a Conekta-issued PUBLIC key, not an HMAC shared secret. NO timestamp is covered, so a timestamp-window defence is impossible; replay mitigation must be event-id dedup only. Merchant creates an RSA keypair once via POST /webhook_keys.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Bearer token with `key_` prefix — `Authorization: Bearer key_XXXX`. Separate public (frontend tokenization) and private (backend) keys per sandbox/production mode. Note: the webhook public key is a SEPARATE RSA PEM, not the API key.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. No current public rate card verified in 2026. Do not populate.

notes: The default Mexican-owned gateway for MXN settlement with a domestic entity. Stripe MX exists but Conekta is the local incumbent for OXXO + SPEI cash/transfer flows and is frequently the only option for merchants who cannot satisfy Stripe MX onboarding.
SDKs: Official libraries published by Conekta for Node, Python, PHP, Ruby, Java and C# (OpenAPI-generated, v6 line). Confirm exact package names at publish time.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps stripe (MX) and openpay. Choose conekta when the merchant needs a Mexican entity, OXXO-first checkout, or SPEI CLABE issuance.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
